title: Components, materials and coordination expansion
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product from the compatibility-grade reusable components/materials/coordination baseline into a bounded professional parity layer, adding richer component-library semantics, deterministic definition-to-instance propagation, canonical material authoring/assignment, stronger coordination data and parity-grade persistence/exchange while preserving frozen ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: Representative reusable component definitions produce multiple instances with stable canonical definition/instance relationships, extending rather than duplicating COMPAT-BIM-003 semantics.
Definition edits propagate deterministically, expose affected instances, create immutable revisions and preserve per-instance overrides.
Material definitions and assignments are canonical, deterministic and independent of OCCT/IfcOpenShell internals, with explicit type-vs-instance precedence.
Coordination sets, grids, levels, reference planes and supported alignment/reference relationships persist through save/open/replay with deterministic semantics.
Construction Graph mappings remain keyed by document-owned canonical identities; engine-native ids remain provenance only.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic streams and canonical serialized results for representative P012 workflows.
IFC import/export preserves supported component/material semantics and reports explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED outcomes outside the supported exchange contract.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..011, COMPAT-BIM-003 and COMPAT-IFC-001 fixtures remain green and byte-identical unless an explicitly reviewed migration is necessary.
Real OCCT/IFC behavior continues through the existing EngineAdapterBundle/worker boundary; no renderer/application engine-internal imports are introduced.
The exact final implementation head is CI-verified and browser/Electron verified; implementation stops at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: Architecture changes without an explicit ACR.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-011 is now VERIFIED after its original historical governance defects were reconciled through ARCH-WF-002 without rewriting the original merge event.
COMPAT-BIM-003 is VERIFIED and is the compatibility-grade component/material/coordination baseline; P012 must extend it rather than recreate it.
RESEARCH-CAD-007 is VERIFIED and establishes the engine-independent canonical semantics and replaceable adapter boundary.
COMPAT-IFC-001 is VERIFIED and provides the production IFC exchange baseline and pinned toolchain behavior.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P012.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic component-definition/instance, propagation, material, coordination and revision tests.
Web/Electron parity fixtures for representative P012 workflows.
Real-OCCT/IFC coverage through the existing adapter/worker boundary plus explicit typed declines for unsupported features.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..011, COMPAT-BIM-003 and COMPAT-IFC-001 remain green and byte-identical.
Exact-head Vercel deployment and real-browser/Electron evidence.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering the final implementation and post-merge verification.

transitions.reason: CAD-PARITY-012 is released from the authoritative CAD/BIM roadmap as the next bounded parity slice after verified CAD-PARITY-011 and ARCH-WF-002. Scope explicitly layers professional parity on top of the verified COMPAT-BIM-003 compatibility baseline.

All declared P012 dependencies are VERIFIED on main: CAD-PARITY-011, COMPAT-BIM-003, RESEARCH-CAD-007 and COMPAT-IFC-001. The work item is assigned to the logical implementation agent z-ai-implementation-agent; the implementation must stop at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review.

Implementation begins for CAD-PARITY-012 after the registration governance gate passed at mainline revision 4a4bd220. Scope is the released Issue #102 parity slice: extend COMPAT-BIM-003 rather than duplicate it, preserve the frozen architecture, and satisfy the P012 acceptance and evidence requirements before stopping at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.

The P012 implementation is complete and verified end-to-end at implementation head 1825c04 and submitted as PR #103: the shared core (the materials/components/grids/coordination app-api surface + the registry commands), the Web host (the Coordination palette, material display resolution, grid bubbles, revision clouds, the report intercepts), the pinned Web-host parity smoke + the CI workflow. All local gates green: the full app suite 1133/0 fail, tsc clean (app, root, Electron), governance validate 384/384, check-protected PASS, the fixture byte-match including a fresh-server restart, and the real-browser golden path 20/20 with zero page errors. Stopping at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for the Architect review per the work order — no APPROVED/VERIFIED claim.
Verification evidence submitted for Architect review at PR head 82da455 (PR #103): the dedicated CAD-PARITY-012 CI green on the exact head and the governance suite green; EV-001..EV-003 complete.

Architect review of CAD-PARITY-012 / PR #103 against the Issue #102 acceptance bar: repository implementation and CI evidence were strong, but exact-head Vercel deployment and real-browser evidence were initially unfulfilled; DEC-001 issued.
Architect review complete — CHANGES REQUESTED under DEC-001 because Issue #102's exact-head Vercel deployment and real-browser evidence requirement was unmet.
transitions.failure_reason: EV-003 was bound to the implementation sandbox rather than the exact repository-side deployment; remediation required deployment of PR #103 head 82da455 with revision-bound browser evidence.

transitions.reason: DEC-001 remediation complete — exact PR #103 head 82da455 deployed to Offisos Vercel, deployment identity verified, 21/21 real-browser protocol checks passed against the deployment, and deployed P012/regression fixtures byte-matched. PR resubmitted for Architect re-review.

DEC-001 remediation evidence is complete and independently reviewable: exact-head deployment and exact-final record deployment are identity-bound, 21/21 deployed browser checks pass with zero page errors, the deployed P012 fixture and all ten regression fixtures byte-match, and final-head CI is green.
Final Architect re-review confirms the DEC-001 evidence requirement is satisfied and the implementation remains within frozen Architecture v1.1.
P012 satisfies Issue #102's acceptance criteria and frozen Architecture v1.1; no blocking implementation, governance, deployment or evidence defect remains.
PR #103 merged with the exact reviewed head 7231b738 pinned.
Post-merge verification on the actual mainline merge revision passed the governance, OCCT/IFC, Web and Electron gates. The merged implementation remains revision-consistent and regression-safe.

decisions.rationale: Architect review of CAD-PARITY-012 / PR #103: the implementation and CI evidence were strong, but the exact-head Vercel deployment and real-browser evidence requirement was initially unmet. The Vercel project authorization was unavailable at review time, so the evidence-chain gate could not be independently established.
